CSS is 71KB compiled Tailwind v4 with `@layer` directives and `@property` rules. This works as-is in modern browsers. I'll scope it under `.mm-dashboard` by wrapping. But `@layer` and `@property` can't easily be nested via a prefix, and the project's build pipeline (Vite + UnoCSS + SCSS) may try to process this CSS.

Safer approach: include the CSS as a raw `.css` asset imported by the Vue page's `<style>` via `@import`, OR inject it as a `<style>` tag in the component's `src` import. Actually simplest: put it in `src/views/property/marketMonitor/dashboard.css` and `import './dashboard.css'` in the `.vue`. Vite will bundle it. To avoid global leakage, I'll prefix selectors with `.mm-dashboard ` programmatically... but `@layer`/`@property`/keyframes complicate.

Alternative & cleanest: keep CSS global but ensure our class usage is unique (Tailwind classes are already global-ish, but the project has its own UnoCSS; conflicts possible on same class names like `flex`, `p-2`). Since UnoCSS values differ (numeric px), a global Tailwind CSS could break OTHER pages.

**Best solution:** Scope by wrapping the dashboard in a Shadow DOM? Overkill. Instead: prefix ALL rules with `.mm-dashboard`. I can do this with a CSS transform: parse and prefix selectors, keeping at-rules (`@layer`, `@property`, `@media`, `@keyframes`, `@supports`) intact and only prefixing inner selectors. Let me write a robust-enough prefixer. Given Tailwind v4 output is flat mostly (single-class selectors), this is feasible.

<template>
  <svg
    xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"
    :width="size"
    :height="size"
    viewBox="0 0 24 24"
    fill="none"
    stroke="currentColor"
    :stroke-width="strokeWidth"
    stroke-linecap="round"
    stroke-linejoin="round"
    :class="['lucide', 'lucide-' + name]"
    aria-hidden="true"
    v-html="inner"
  ></svg>
</template>

<script>
import icons from '../assets/icons.js'

export default {
  name: 'LucideIcon',
  props: {
    name: { type: String, required: true },
    size: { type: [Number, String], default: 24 },
    strokeWidth: { type: [Number, String], default: 2 }
  },
  computed: {
    inner() {
      const nodes = icons[this.name]
      if (!nodes) return ''
      return nodes
        .map(n => {
          const attrs = Object.keys(n.attrs)
            .map(k => `${k}="${n.attrs[k]}"`)
            .join(' ')
          return `<${n.tag} ${attrs}></${n.tag}>`
        })
        .join('')
    }
  }
}
</script>

Model on how the 套数走势/面积走势 tab switching works in source (same button styling).
   b. Inside the 未售情况 tab, the bottom bar chart (柱状图) must be TALLER than original so it fits (currently cramped). Increase its height (e.g. add explicit taller height / min-height to the chart container and give the chart more vertical space) while keeping all other styling.
   Keep all other layout/styles identical. Use ChartBox for charts.
2) components/BuyerOverviewPanel.vue <- Bee (购房人总览).
   ORIGINAL: left = 户籍与年龄结构 line chart with 户籍/年龄 toggle (2 tabs), right = 付款方式结构 pie (商业贷款/一次性付款/分期付款) with 3 stat cards below.

Currently it was a donut on top with 3 cards in a row below; convert to left chart + right legend list layout. Keep the 户籍与年龄结构 chart unchanged (left half of the panel).
   Overall panel remains: left half = 购房人 户籍/年龄 chart, right half = 付款方式(now left-right donut+legend). 
3) DetailModalA.vue (Vee), 4) DetailModalB.vue (Hee), 5) DetailModalC.vue (Uee) — the 更多数据/明细弹窗. Props: visible (Boolean), computedData/quantityData, trendData, areaData, propertyData, districtData; emit 'close'. Uee is the main 4-tab 明细表 (10区县明细表/近12月月度明细/面积段分布表/房屋性质构成表) with CSV export + zoom/fullscreen. Port faithfully.

## 交付内容

**新增页面**：`src/views/property/marketMonitor/index.vue` + 13 个子组件（`components/`）
- 独立成页，不覆盖原有 `/dashboard`（那是另一个「物业管理可视化」大屏）
- 路由 `#/market-monitor`（已加入白名单），首页 [index-new.vue](<zhi2-web-admin/src/views/home/index-new.vue>) 的 `handleStatsMore` 改为 `$router.push('/market-monitor')`

**保真方式**：复用原单文件里编译好的 Tailwind CSS，按 `.mm-dashboard` 作用域隔离（拆掉 `@layer` 以与项目 UnoCSS 正常竞争层叠），DOM 类名逐字还原；echarts 配置对象原样搬运；lucide 图标从原包提取成组件；数据/主题全部程序化抽取为 `assets/data.js`。

## 关键验证结果

| 项 | 结果 |
|---|---|
| **E2E 断言** | 29 项全部通过（结构/无遮挡/多分辨率/交互/无运行时错误）|
| **像素对比（原版 vs 移植版 @1920×1080）** | **差异 2.43%（相同 97.57%）**，>95% 要求达标 |
| **分辨率兼容** | 1920×1040 整页完整可见**无遮挡**（`docH=winH=1040`，底部板块边 1026px 在视口内）；1366×768 自然滚动不重叠 |

E2E 规格已落在 [market-monitor-visual.spec.ts](<zhi2-web-admin/tests/e2e/market-monitor-visual.spec.ts>)（项目 playwright 版本浏览器需 `npx playwright install chromium`；本次用已装浏览器以等效独立 runner 完成同套校验并产出截图）。

## 按要求做的三处调整
1. **付款方式结构**：改为与「各板块成交套数比例」一致的**左图右表**布局（环形图在左，商业贷款/一次性付款/分期付款 图例+金额+占比在右）。
2. **未售情况改为 tab**：与「套数走势 / 面积走势」并列，切换后才显示三张未售卡片。
3. **未售柱状图加高**：卡片压缩为单行紧凑条，柱状图区 `min-h-[150px]` 且 `flex-1`，三根柱完整显示、不再放不下。

其余部分 100% 还原（差异图见上方，红色区域仅集中在上述三处有意调整 + 实时时钟文字 + 抗锯齿）。
